# MFA push notifications not delivered to a subset of users

Some users never receive the MFA push prompt and are locked out after the timeout; SMS fallback works.

After a mobile OS update, device push tokens were rotated but the MFA app failed to re-register the new token with the provider, so pushes went to dead tokens.

1. Correlate affected users to a recent device OS upgrade
2. Force the MFA app to re-register push tokens on next launch
3. Purge invalidated tokens (APNs 410 / FCM NotRegistered) from the provider
4. Confirm push delivery for a re-registered test device

Error Details
```
MFA provider log: APNs response 410 'Unregistered'; FCM error 'NotRegistered'; push token invalidated after device OS upgrade
```

Tags: auth, mfa, push, apns-410, token-registration
